_about: Every payment option the app supports. All start OFF except cash; link and switch them on in the app (Settings > Payments) whenever you're ready, and switch them off again any time. 'setup' says what linking needs: 'connect' = sign in to the provider's account; 'handle' = type your username/phone/email; 'none' = nothing. 'canGuarantee' = the app can charge it later without the client (no-show / late-cancel fees).

methods.label: Credit / debit card
methods._note: Linked together by connecting one Stripe account (sole proprietor). Each can then be switched on separately.

methods.label: Google Pay
methods._note: Linked together by connecting one Stripe account (sole proprietor). Each can then be switched on separately.

methods.label: Apple Pay
methods._note: Linked together by connecting one Stripe account (sole proprietor). Each can then be switched on separately.

methods.label: Cash App Pay
methods._note: Linked together by connecting one Stripe account (sole proprietor). Each can then be switched on separately.

methods.label: PayPal
methods._note: Phase 2. Saved PayPal for later charges needs PayPal's vault feature; confirm during setup.

methods.label: Venmo
methods._note: Phase 2, through PayPal checkout. Same vault caveat as PayPal.

methods.label: Venmo (send to my profile)
methods._note: Use a Venmo business profile; personal accounts aren't meant for business payments.

methods.label: Zelle
methods._note: Phone or email registered with Zelle. Zelle has no payment link, so clients see your Zelle info, and you mark it paid when it arrives.

methods.label: Apple Cash
methods._note: Sent from Messages or Wallet on iPhone to your phone number. No payment link. You need an iPhone to receive it.
